text:
Maya Chen: Quick weekly sync on Greenfield Labs usage + latency. TL;DR: p95s improved slightly, p99 tail still spiky on chat non-streaming. Sharing the route/model split and streaming vs non-streaming numbers we pulled this morning.
Telemetry Bot: auto-report: Greenfield Labs • 7d window • routes: /v1/chat, /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings • models: rwl-7b, rwl-13b • modes: streaming, sync
Telemetry Bot: metrics (p95 / p99) by route/model/mode — compacted: 
`/v1/chat (rwl-13b) streaming: p95=220ms p99=760ms`
`/v1/chat (rwl-13b) sync:      p95=480ms p99=1.4s`
`/v1/generate (rwl-7b) streaming: p95=180ms p99=520ms`
`/v1/generate (rwl-7b) sync:      p95=360ms p99=900ms`
`/v1/embeddings (rwl-7b) sync:    p95=120ms p99=310ms`
Telemetry Bot: error rate: 5xx = 0.14% (7d avg), client errors 4xx = 0.9% (mostly rate-limited spikes). Spend: $18.6k last 7d (+12% w/w). QPS: median 65 qps, peak 420 qps (UTC-08).
Liam O'Connor: Thanks — good detail. Customer asked for target: chat p95 <= 200ms. We're ~20% over on streaming p95 and ~2.4x on sync. Renewal convo next month; flagging as possible risk if we can't hit 200ms.
Diego Ruiz: Noted. Preliminary root-cause: a small fraction of long-tail requests are hitting model fallback to rwl-13b-sync when cached KV not present. Also autoscaler scale-up lag for dedicated pool during the 03:00 UTC spike.
Nina Patel: Can we quantify how many requests hit the fallback? If it's <1% maybe we can mitigate with routing tweaks.
Telemetry Bot: fallback hit-rate (7d): 0.7% of chat requests. When fallback occurs, p99 jumps to ~2.6s for that bucket.
Maya Chen: Action items: Diego to test a routing rule to prefer streaming-compatible variant for Greenfield's primary model (reduce fallbacks). Nina to coordinate a short enablement doc for Greenfield devs on recommended call patterns (prefix caching + streaming chunking). Liam to surface the 200ms ask in renewal prep.
Diego Ruiz: Will run a test change tomorrow 09:30 PT. Test plan: add a hard-route for greenfield-prod -> rwl-13b-streaming primaries, add aggressive prefix cache for typical prompt patterns. I'll post results.
Liam O'Connor: Also note spend uptick tied to long responses from a few QA users — asked them to check token limits. Could be quick win to reduce cost.
Maya Chen: Agree. Nina, can you send a 1-pager with the quick SDK tips and recommended token cap settings? We can attach to the renewal deck.
Nina Patel: Yep — I'll draft and share by EOD tomorrow.
Maya Chen: ETA for measurable p95 improvement? If Diego's routing test reduces fallback from 0.7% to <0.1% we should see p95 drop ~10-12% and p99 tail material drop. If autoscale lag is fixed we may hit 200ms target for streaming.
Diego Ruiz: I'll include autoscaler tweak in test. If greenfield's peak pattern repeats in the test window we'll push to prod canary.
Liam O'Connor: Good. I'll prep the renewal risk note: currently low-medium; will update after test.
Maya Chen: Thanks team. If anyone sees error spikes overnight ping #eng-oncall and drop any logs in this thread.
Telemetry Bot: sample command to reproduce metrics query:
```
rdl metrics query --customer greenfield-labs --window 7d --group-by route,model,mode --percentiles 95,99 --format table
```
Maya Chen: End of thread—will follow up with test outcome and updated metrics next Tue. :thumbsup:
